title: PNG/PDF export regression corpus and fidelity report expansion
outcome: A versioned export regression corpus (documents plus expected PDF operator topology and PNG pixel checksums) is checked in and runnable, so compound-path behavior proven by VIRO-0005 becomes part of the standing baseline and future exporter changes are measured against real artifacts, with the export report expanded to cover every claimed classification.
before: VIRO-0005 delivered compound-contour vector PDF export with targeted tests (tests/pdf-compound.test.mjs, tests/pdf-compound.spec.ts), but there is no standing versioned corpus of export documents covering single/compound/stroke/effects/text/raster mixes, and PdfExportReport coverage of every field it reports is incomplete.
after: One command regenerates and one command verifies the corpus; every corpus document has committed expected artifacts (operator-level for PDF, checksums for PNG); report fields (vectorPaths, rasterFallbacks, others) each have an assertion.
acceptance: Corpus includes: single-contour vector, compound boolean ring, disjoint union, stroke-only, fill+stroke, text layer, raster layer, and effects layer.
Verification command fails on any operator-topology or pixel-checksum divergence.
Every PdfExportReport field asserted at least once across the corpus.
npx tsc --noEmit, corpus suite and npm run build pass.
evidence: Deliberate-mutation check: one seeded exporter mutation makes verification fail (corpus is not vacuous)

builder.notes: Built on branch agent/viro-0015/zcode-gov-audit-pc1 from base 72b05f0 (VIRO-0005 + VIRO-0145 already merged in). Corpus lands as tests/export-corpus-{docs,verify,png}.mjs + export-corpus.test.mjs + export-corpus-png.json. The two compound cases banked DEFERRED-UNTIL-REBASE were ACTIVATED against the merged exporter and their post-rebase expectations held (subtract ring and disjoint union both emit m:2 h:2 f*:1 with fill 0; no exporter defect found). Two further cases added for acceptance coverage: compound-stroke-only (S + w, no fill ops) and compound-fill-stroke (B*). EFFECTS FIDELITY DECISION (recorded at claim): the exporter ignores layer.effects entirely and records no note; the corpus PINS this current behaviour — the effects case's PDF report and operator census are pinned IDENTICAL to an unshadowed control, while the PNG arm pins a DIFFERENT compositor fingerprint, proving the canvas draws the shadow the PDF drops. Canvas/PDF parity gap + missing report note are exporter findings reported under this packet, not fixed here (QA-corpus packet, per packet rules). The PNG arm runs the real compositor through a playwright harness (tests/export-corpus-png.mjs, ensureServer + SwiftShader launch args); fingerprints are decoded-IDAT SHA-256 pinned in tests/export-corpus-png.json; regenerate deliberately with CORPUS_PIN=1. Verification command (single): node --experimental-strip-types --import ./tests/ts-register.mjs --test tests/export-corpus.test.mjs. Note: tests/export-corpus-ck.mjs (banked CanvasKit bootstrap draft) is superseded by the runner's inline bootstrap and intentionally left uncommitted. Verdict is the verifier's to give.
proof: corpus suite: 13/13 (9 corpus documents; manifest guard, 9 pdf-arm report+topology tests, effects-vs-control parity pin, png fingerprint arm, vacuity self-check)
vacuity (comparator level): mutationSelfChecks rejects content-hash, topology-expectation and png-pixel-hash mutations; the runner fails the suite unless all three are caught
vacuity (end to end): one corrupted PNG pin digit in tests/export-corpus-png.json made the png arm FAIL (pass 12 / fail 1), then restored — the verification command really bites on pixel divergence
determinism: pins reproduced across two independent full runs (identical sha256 per case); effects fingerprint e0c53aa2... != control 8512f183... (canvas draws the shadow)
every corpus row pins ALL seven PdfExportReport fields (assertReportCoverage enforces pagePt, vectorPaths, textRuns, glyphs, images, rasterFallbacks, notes per case)
npm run test:unit -> tests 316, pass 316, fail 0 (baseline unchanged)
prior packet suites re-run untouched: tests/pdf-compound.test.mjs 5/5 + tests/pdf-font-embed.test.mjs 5/5 (10/10)
npm run build -> exit 0 (full dist/ emitted, 47M)

critic.notes: Test/QA corpus; no product behavior change intended.

delta.before: Point tests for compound export; no standing corpus or report-field coverage.
delta.after: Versioned corpus with artifact-level verification commands and full report-field assertions.
proof: tests/export-corpus.test.mjs 13/13 via node --test (pdf operator topology, all-field report assertions, PNG decoded-IDAT sha256 pins through the playwright/compositor harness, vacuity self-check)
deliberate corruption of one committed PNG pin fails the suite (recorded), and mutationSelfChecks rejects hash/topology/pixel mutations at comparator level
regression_protection: tests/pdf-compound.* remain green and are folded into the corpus
delta.new_debt: Exporter findings reported, not fixed (QA-corpus packet): (1) layer.effects are dropped in PDF export with no report note (pinned via effects-vs-control parity); (2) tests/export-corpus-ck.mjs banked draft superseded, left uncommitted; (3) one observed chromium launch crash under heavy concurrent browser load (same flake class playwright.config retries cover) — a plain re-run passed.
